summary: Detect only active ancestor cycles during JSON.stringify, throwing TypeError while allowing repeated non-cyclic references.

target.notes: The helper must maintain the ECMAScript serialization Stack. Re-entering an object already on that active stack throws TypeError; an object reused after its prior serialization completed is allowed.

semantics.identity: cycle detection uses object identity, not structural equality
semantics.shared_reference: same object in separate non-ancestor positions serializes more than once
semantics.stack_unwind: objects are removed from the active stack after each object/array completes

caveats: A global visited set is wrong because it rejects harmless repeated references.

tests.name: ancestor cycle throws
tests.input: const a={}; a.self=a; try { JSON.stringify(a); } catch(e) { console.log(e instanceof TypeError); }
